issues.title: Julia model universe absent
issues.finding: 82 entries have no exact Julia architecture/task inventory;R7/R8 are different engines and cannot substitute.
issues.proposed_resolution: Import2151 task keys with exact version/model/target/horizon/fold/feature removal. Keep v1/v2/v3 provenance separately;v2 corrected inputs had no fits. No refitting.

issues.title: Completed task is not retained executable model
issues.finding: Final wrappers reuse original kernels. ridge beta and dropgroup/drop_history tree weights are not serialized by reviewed path. completed() requires weights only for standard evotrees and nonconstant neural. Archive completion does not prove2151 deployable predictors.
issues.proposed_resolution: Keep mathematical rule,missing-state and archive attestation separate. Recover exact A/B/C/D members without workers. No silent refit/generic replacement.

issues.title: Targets and nondirectional outputs conflated
issues.finding: Occurrence,signed,absolute,quantiles and clusters answer different questions. Negative magnitudes,crossed intervals and constant predictions remain recorded.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use separate candidates below. Any directional execution translation for nondirectional outputs is a new design choice.

preprocess.formula: Train-only: retain finite nonconstant columns(std>1e-12);median impute,standardize,clamp[-20,20];append missing indicators for partly missing train columns. Do not replace raw source states.

ridge100.formula: mu=mean(train_y);centered=y-mu;beta=A.T @ solve(A@A.T+100I,centered) when rows<=cols,else solve(A.T@A+100I,A.T@centered);prediction=mu+B@beta. Binary predictions clamped[1e-6,1-1e-6].
ridge100.artifact_gap: Beta not serialized by reviewed completed path. Recomputing beta is a refit,not recovery of an existing executable artifact.

configuration.loss: logloss for occurrence;mae for evotrees_mae;quantile alpha0.1/0.9 for q10/q90;otherwise mse

evotrees.prediction: Nonbinary train target z=(y-mu)/max(std(y),1e-8);prediction=mu+scale*tree(B);binary raw output then clamp. dropgroup/drop_history use depth3 default with exact source columns removed,not score masking.
evotrees.artifact_gap: Standard tree fitted states serialized;dropgroup/drop_history fit states deliberately not serialized.

neural.inference: Per observation,freeze original prep/model/target normalization;binary clamp;constant target uses mean,no fit. Raw negative magnitudes retained.
